content.title: 冲击停顿｜第二角色入场与近景确认
content.summary: 局部冲击固定空间，短暂停顿后第二角色入场回应，最终以主角近景确认。

quick_start.input_format: 固定空间＋一次冲击＋警觉停顿＋第二角色回应
quick_start.recommended_input: 洁净工业测试厅、红框校准区、一块轻质泡棉测试块、两台外形不同的自动巡检机器人。
required_anchors: 第二角色在停顿后入场
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 局部冲击固定空间，短暂停顿后第二角色入场回应，最终以主角近景确认。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: A sudden localized impact pins the first agent in one geometry; a guarded pause and offscreen anticipation precede a second entrant's brief tightly bounded exchange, then a close stable view identifies the primary agent.

invariants.rule: An abrupt arrival or impact establishes one fixed pressure point in the scene.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the pressure point the later hold lacks cause.

invariants.rule: Hold the first agent visibly poised while a second agent is delayed offscreen.
invariants.purpose: Lets stillness store energy and direct gaze.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate back-to-back impacts erase contrast and anticipation.

invariants.rule: The second arrival triggers one short readable exchange, then isolate the first agent in a final identity hold.
invariants.purpose: Converts tension into action and closes on a stable subject.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the final frame is only chaotic motion, response and continuity are lost.

slots.name: first_agent
slots.constraint: One clearly stable adult or machine.

slots.name: pressure_point
slots.constraint: Visible safe localized impact and persistent mark or object.

slots.name: second_agent
slots.constraint: Enters only after readable quiet hold.

slots.name: exchange
slots.constraint: Short legible interaction without inferred injury.

anti_copy_exclusions: No subway platform, passing train, tiled cylinder, damaged wall pattern, original woman's likeness or exact fighting choreography.
No unsupported injury, fatality or hidden motive claim.
Targets use safe non-contact or machine interaction, not real interpersonal harm.

instantiations.concept: In a clean industrial test hall, one autonomous inspection robot stops abruptly beside a red-marked pressure pad after a harmless foam calibration block drops from a ceiling rig directly into its forward sensor lane. The robot visibly detects the block and brakes before it. Its front sensor remains aimed at an empty entry lane during a long motor-idle hold. A second contrasting robot rolls in; the two execute a tightly spaced but non-colliding exchange of calibration arms at the same pad. End close on the first robot's sensor, both machines and dropped foam block still in their original positions.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Two industrial inspection robots, foam block impact, waiting sensor, safe calibration-arm exchange.

instantiations.concept: In a brightly lit competitive dance rehearsal, an unambiguously adult lead dancer lands on one marked stage square as a lightweight scenic curtain snaps down behind her. She holds a poised stance while another adult partner enters from offstage; they trade three precise non-contact gesture phrases. End on the lead dancer's controlled gaze, with the curtain and stage mark unchanged.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Adult dance rehearsal, scenic curtain drop, poised dancer, non-contact duet and final gaze.

failure_modes.failure: Second agent enters before a distinct held pause.
failure_modes.repair: Leave several beats with first agent visibly ready.

failure_modes.failure: Exchange becomes continuous chaotic camera motion.
failure_modes.repair: Keep marked floor location and short alternating actions visible.
Retain the original safe impact object/mark in the ending geography.
